items.title: With fewer Canadian tourists, Nevada hotel owner urges Americans to vote for change
items.summary: With the number of international visitors on the decline, a hotel owner in Nevada is urging Americans to vote carefully in the upcoming U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: Quebec premier agrees to meet Carney, asks for Quebec City venue
items.summary: Quebec Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon announced Sunday that he had accepted Prime Minister Mark Carney’s invitation to meet following the Canada-European Union summit dispute.

items.title: Carney to meet with King Charles and Commonwealth heads of government
items.summary: Commonwealth members include large countries like the United Kingdom, Australia, India and Nigeria, and many of the world’s smallest countries, such as Tuvalu.

items.title: City of Toronto opens the 2026 Vacant Home Tax declaration period
items.summary: News Release November 2, 2026 The City of Toronto’s online portal is now available for residential property owners to submit their 2026 Vacant Home Tax (VHT) declarations.
